http_port.description: The TCP port number where Squid listens for HTTP requests.

icp_port.description: The TCP port number where Squid listens for ICP requests.

cache_type.description: The type of cache storage to use (e.g., ufs, rock, directory).

cache_dir_path.description: The directory path where cache data is stored.

cache_size.description: The maximum disk space to use for the cache, in megabytes.

level1.description: The number of first-level subdirectories for the cache.

level2.description: The number of second-level subdirectories for the cache.

maximum_object_size_kb.description: Maximum object size allowed in the cache, in kilobytes.

pid_filename.description: Path to the file where Squid stores its PID.

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file.

error_directory.description: Directory containing Squid error page templates.

cache_mgr_email.description: Email address of the cache manager, used in error pages.

visible_hostname.description: Hostname displayed in error pages and cache manager responses.

localnet_cidrs.description: List of CIDR networks considered local and allowed access.

sslcrtd_program.description: Path to the SSL certificate generation helper program.

sslcrtd_children.description: Number of parallel instances of the SSL certificate generation helper.

sslcrtd_timeout.description: Timeout for SSL certificate generation operations, in seconds.

tls_outgoing_options.description: Options for outgoing TLS connections (e.g., SNI support).

auth_basic_program.description: Path to the PAM authentication helper program.

auth_basic_children.description: Number of parallel instances of the basic authentication helper.

auth_basic_realm.description: Realm string for the authentication popup.

auth_basic_credentialsttl.description: Time-to-live for authenticated credentials, in hours.
